plugins.name: adage
plugins.description: Agent traces become reflexes: Adage learns the paths your agents take in each repository and tells them, deterministically, what to do next. Works from the first session: binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows are bundled and verified; nothing is downloaded.

plugins.name: adage-exec
plugins.description: Adage with execution (opt-in): after `adage delegate on` and a person's `adage review delegate` per reflex, observe-only lookups run in an OS sandbox at the stimulus and their typed output arrives beside the directive (E1), and approved actions such as `make gen` after an edit run staged, verified and applied from the hook (E2). Replaces the Adage plugin's hooks while execution is on. Binaries bundled.
